categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies wallet coin selection code in src/wallet/spend.cpp and wallet tests.
categories.rationale: Fixes a latent crash bug in `AvailableCoins()` when called without explicit coin control while unconfirmed mempool coins exist. Commit 6a5577f100 notes that 'the TRUC version filter added in ec2676becd does not [check for null]... dereferences a null pointer', though no current production caller hits this path because 'RPCs, the GUI and CreateTransaction always pass a coin control'.
